facts.text: Audrey's dog pulled so hard on the leash that it broke last Friday at the park.

evidence.quote: last Friday at the park one of my pups saw something and pulled so hard the leash busted.

facts.text: Audrey chased after her dog to prevent her from getting hurt after the leash broke.

evidence.quote: I had to chase after her. Luckily I caught her before anything bad happened.

facts.text: Audrey petted, hugged, and spoke calmly to her dog to help her relax after the incident.

evidence.quote: I petted and hugged her, spoke calmly, and slowly walked her to relax.

facts.text: Audrey believes that moments like the incident strengthen the bond between a dog and its owner.

evidence.quote: Little moments like this remind me how important she is and how we should be careful when we're out there.
Our bond feels even stronger when moments like these show up.
